name: @corbits/workflow-authoring-tools
description: author_workflow/republish_workflow and deploy_workflow as an @intx/agent tool bundle — an agent authors a workflow codebase as code into the hub's git-backed asset store (@corbits/agent-workflow-authoring's workflow-run-authenticated routes) and deploys it through @intx/hub-api's existing source-based deploy route. deploy_workflow carries approval:"ask": deploying runs the workflow for real, the external-side-effect gate every state-changing action in this codebase sits behind
